not printed: groupc:note names the reporting definitions at the pinned commit
notes.printed: Path, Commit and SHA-256 are each file's entry in the claims ledger's sources field, {path, commit, sha256}, so a ledger row and this table cite a file the same way. The commit is the last commit on main that touched the file: for each data file, the commit that added it; for Study 1's reporting definitions, the revision that the Study 1 analysis and the keep-list analyses cite. Each file is read from that commit, and its SHA-256 is checked against the bytes before any table is built.
raw: the last commit on main that touched the file

notes.formula: text cut /research/reporting\-definitions\-main\.md \([0-9a-f]{7}[^)]*\), items (\d+-\d+)\b/ group 1; the record's hyphen in a range is printed as an en dash (house style); text cut /research/reporting\-definitions\-main\.md \([0-9a-f]{7}[^)]*\), items (\d+-\d+)\b/ group 1; the record's hyphen in a range is printed as an en dash (house style); text cut /research/reporting\-definitions\-main\.md \(([0-9a-f]{7})\b/ group 1; not printed: main:reporting.group_b.note names the reporting definitions at the pinned commit; text cut /research/reporting\-definitions\-main\.md \(([0-9a-f]{7})\b/ group 1; not printed: groupc:note names the reporting definitions at the pinned commit
notes.printed: Item numbers in the appendix tables ('item N') refer to the numbered items of Study 1's reporting definitions at that revision: the Study 1 analysis cites items 7–24 there, and the keep-list analyses items 1–24.

Code commit: the commit the analysis ran at, from our work log's entry for each driver run (the top-up file stamps its own). Run file recorded: the run file whose SHA-256 the analysis file itself records about its inputs (for the Study 1 analysis, the compact table that k was computed from); each equals the hash in that run's row of our cost records (the run panel). A dash: no such record (our work log names no commit for the curve runs, and the curve files record no run-file hash; the reporting definitions are a text file, not a run's output). Commits here and in the run panel are shortened to their first seven characters.

notes.formula: text cut /^- Tools: (.+)\.$/ group 1; text cut /^\*\*5\.4 (Code used after the locks)\.\*\*/ group 1; not printed: the record for 'section 5.4 is the record of the code used after the locks'; text cut /^(anthropic==\S+)$/ group 1
